messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — High p99/tail latency for streaming responses on cross-AZ path az-b -> az-c. Paging oncall-net.

marta: seeing p95 ~ 400ms and p99 up to 3.2s for streaming token arrival. Clients report stalls and reconnects. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/streams?range=15m

raj: confirmed elevated TLS handshake times in flow logs. Packet loss spike between az-b and az-c ~23:12 UTC. Flow logs show 0.8-1.5% packet loss, SYN retransmits high.

kevin: any recent infra changes? LB rules, NAT updates, or provider notices?

sasha: no LB changes in last 24h. There was an autoscale event in az-c ~22:50 but nodes healthy. Suspecting NAT port exhaustion on cross-az NAT gateway.

oncall-net: I’m on it. Collecting tcpdump from a few failing pods. If NAT ephemeral ports exhausted we’ll see SYN+RSTs and stalled new TLS sessions.

marta: customer-impact: 4 hosted API customers showing increased error/stall rates (cust-acme, cust-lumos, cust-ora, cust-fleetly). Two Dedicated pools in eu-west with higher tail latency for long responses.

jordan-customer-success: pinged enterprise contacts; customers are reporting streaming stalls lasting 10–30s and reconnect loops — escalating.

eng-runbook-bot: Runbook: Networking - Cross-AZ packet loss/TLS: https://runbooks.internal/networking-cross-az. Steps: 1) Check NAT metrics 2) Reroute egress 3) Open cloud-net ticket.

oncall-net: NAT gateway metrics show high connections count on az-b->az-c path. SNAT port exhaustion looks likely. Starting mitigation: attach spare NAT gateway and update route table to prefer it for egress to az-c.

kevin: +1 to add NAT. Also propose routing new streaming sessions to AZ-local instances when possible to avoid cross-zone. Might need runtime change for sticky routing.

raj: quick mitigation: enable TLS session resumption cache on edge LB for clients that support it — reduces full handshakes. Pushing edge config now (rolling, ~2m).

marta: applying limited traffic shift: prefer az-c local instances for newly created sessions; not touching existing in-flight sessions.

oncall-net: route update applied to rtb-azb-01 -> now uses nat-aux-03. Monitoring packet loss and handshake times.

incident-bot: Mitigation applied by oncall-net at 23:18 UTC. Initial decrease in retransmits observed.

raj: observed p99 handshake drop from 3.2s -> 1.1s after nat-aux switch; p95 from 400ms -> 190ms. Streaming stalls decreased ~65%.

kevin: still seeing intermittent tail spikes ~900ms. Could be ECMP asymmetry causing reordering, or path MTU/fragmentation. Any MTU mismatches?

oncall-net: MTU consistent across ENIs. ECMP hash entropy changing when az-b LB picks different backends. Will pin ECMP hash to reduce reordering.

sasha: rolling ECMP hashing stabilization on edge LBs, 1–2 minute rollout per region.

marta: scaled streaming workers in az-c +20% to absorb queued connections.

jordan-customer-success: notifying affected customers: applied mitigations and monitoring; collecting screenshots and ETA for full recovery.

oncall-net: running pcap analysis to confirm no further packet drops. If drops persist we’ll open cloud provider case for possible fabric flaps.

incident-bot: Severity -> Sev2 (partial degradation) at 23:28 UTC. Paging rotations: oncall-net -> net-senior at 23:35 UTC for handoff.

kevin: handoff note for net-senior: actions performed: nat-aux attached, new session routing pref AZ-local, ECMP pinned, TLS session cache enabled on edge, streaming workers scaled +20% in az-c.

net-senior: received, taking over. I’ll validate cloud-side metrics and open support case if packet loss >0.3% persists for 10m.

marta: customer impact summary for notes: ~4 hosted customers affected, stalls reduced ~65%, p99 improved to ~1.0s. Dedicated: minor tail increases, no errors.

oncall-net: 23:46 UTC — packet loss stable at 0.12%, p99 ~800ms and trending down. Preparing post-incident checklist.

sasha: scheduling follow-up change to rotate primary NAT for az-b during low traffic window and request provider review of NAT capacity.

jordan-customer-success: update sent to customers: "We applied network mitigations and are monitoring. Expect full recovery within 2 hours. We will follow up with an RCA."

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by net-senior at 23:50 UTC. Final timeline and RCA link will be posted in this channel.

marta: thanks all. Keeping watch until SLOs stable and customers confirm. Postmortem assignee: raj (network lead). Draft RCA deadline 48h.

net-senior: handoff complete. Follow-ups: open cloud provider ticket, audit NAT capacity, implement runtime routing tweak to prefer AZ-local sticky sessions, re-evaluate TLS handshake defaults.

incident-bot: Thread moved to monitoring-only phase at 00:12 UTC. Reopen if regressions observed.
